name: Magnit
verdict: Listed Russian grocery retailer; its largest shareholder is Alexander Vinokurov's Marathon Group with about 29% of the shares. Nothing found.
note: Front-of-shirt sponsor on Dynamo Makhachkala's 2026-27 home kit (club kit launch, 2026-07-25). PJSC Magnit is listed on the Moscow Exchange (MGNT; 2025 annual report); around 29.7% are treasury shares held via its own subsidiary Magnit Alyans. No state in the chain and no court, regulator, UN-body or major-NGO human-rights finding against the company found (searched 2026-10-03).
